# `<newlib_compat.h>`

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

POSIX declarations this newlib build leaves out.

Force-included into every tier-2 (newlib) translation unit; see -include in scripts/Makefile.user. The definitions live in lib/posix/stubs.c.

```c
#include <newlib_compat.h>
```

## Functions

### `getline` { #getline }

```c
ssize_t getline(char **lineptr, size_t *n, FILE *stream);
```

POSIX getline(); newlib implements it as __getline() but never declares it.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `lineptr` | inout | Buffer, grown with realloc() as needed; *lineptr may be NULL. |
| `n` | inout | Size of *lineptr. |
| `stream` | in | Stream to read. |

**Returns:** Characters read, including the newline, or -1 at end of file or on error.

### `lstat` { #lstat }

```c
int lstat(const char *path, struct stat *buf);
```

POSIX lstat(); this build makes it an alias of stat().

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `path` | in | Path. |
| `buf` | out | Result. |

**Returns:** 0, or -1 with errno set.
